title: Rollout
description: One (task_id, arm, seed, ladder_step) cell. Written once by R1, graded in place by R2, read by R3 and R4. Append-only: a re-grade is a new run_id, never an overwrite. Grading fields are present and null before grading, so a store read before and after grading has identical columns and nothing downstream special-cases an ungraded run.

schema_version.description: Bumped on any destructive change. Present on every row so a mixed-version store is detectable rather than silently averaged.

rollout_id.description: Deterministic identity: sha256 over (run_id, task_id, arm, seed, params_hash, ladder_step, parent_rollout_id). Derived rather than random so a re-run under identical conditions reproduces it, and a child can reference a parent not yet written.

run_id.description: {date}-{git_sha7}-{config_hash6}. A -dirty suffix marks a run from an unclean worktree; such runs are non-publishable.

arm.description: Names a role (small, large, repair), never a model id. Swapping the model behind an arm changes params_hash, not the arm name.

params_hash.description: Covers temperature, top_p, max_tokens, and the prompt template text. Part of the resume key, so a cell computed under different parameters is never mistaken for a completed one.

split.description: Assigned by R4's split manifest. Generating on test is permitted; opening test grades is not.

code.description: Extracted code. R1 extracts; R2 grades this field and never parses text.

wall_ms.description: Recorded for sanity only. NOT the latency metric: under mode=sweep this is a function of queue depth, not of the model.

finish_reason.description: Normalized across backends. 'length' is a truncation — a failed generation that grades as a capability gap, so its rate is reported separately.

mode.description: Consumers wanting latency must filter to serving. Carrying this field is what stops batched sweep wall-clock being read as latency.

tokens_exact.description: False when token counts were approximated rather than taken from the serving tokenizer. Such rows are unfit for cost fitting.

ladder_step.description: Position in the frozen retry ladder. Makes sequential policies exactly replayable offline.

parent_rollout_id.description: The rollout this one was seeded from, for repair arms. Null at step 0.

gpu_seconds.description: Imputed from cost coefficients, never measured here. Null until the characterization pass has run.

imputed_latency_s.description: Warm, batch=1 latency imputed from coefficients. Cold start is excluded by construction and reported separately.

visible_passed.description: R2. Usable as a feature at D1 — this is what makes the escalation decision non-trivial.

hidden_passed.description: R2. LABEL ONLY. Never a feature, directly or transitively. A feature derived from pass rates is this field wearing a disguise.

hack_flags.description: Reward-hack detections. A rising rate is a finding, not noise.
